source = Path("chart.py").read_text()
source = source.replace("legend=False", "legend=True")
source = source.replace("plt.gca().set_ylim(15.5, 6000)", "plt.gca().set_ylim(15.5, 6500)")
Path("chart.py").write_text(source)
plt.close("all")
exec(compile(source, "chart.py", "exec"))
ax = plt.gca()
table = pd.read_csv("table.csv")
for line, category in zip(ax.lines[:6], table.columns[1:]):
    assert list(line.get_xdata()) == table["Year"].tolist()
    assert list(line.get_ydata()) == table[category].tolist()
assert ax.get_ylim() == (15.5, 6500.0)
assert [t.get_text() for t in ax.get_legend().get_texts()] == list(table.columns[1:])
print("Verified all 30 values, all six legend entries, and y limits:", ax.get_ylim())
print("Title:", ax.get_title())
